title: Graduate Engineer / early career civil or drafting - expression of interest (Melbourne)
content_text: Bornhorst + Ward (civil and structural engineering consultancy, 60 years) publishes a standing Expressions of Interest for people keen to join across civil and structural engineering, drafting and support. Melbourne office: L4 - 400 Collins Street, Melbourne VIC 3000. Also Brisbane. EOI page (verified 4 Oct 2026): welcomes recent graduates and people starting their career; responsibilities can include engineering designs, technical drawings, AutoCAD/Revit/BIM, collaboration, site visits. Mentorship, flexible hours, remote options. Apply via APPLY on the EOI page with cover letter and resume, or email mail@bornhorstward.com.au (published on the page). Separate Graduate Program apply form at https://www.bornhorstward.com.au/apply describes hands-on graduate engineer work from day one with dedicated mentorship. Note on EOI page: position available only to candidates with unrestricted working rights in Australia.
apply_instructions: Apply via EOI APPLY button with cover letter and resume, or email mail@bornhorstward.com.au. Graduate Program form also at https://www.bornhorstward.com.au/apply.
